info.title: Amazon Bedrock Runtime Auth Overlay
info.description: Corrects the authentication scheme for the Amazon Bedrock Runtime API. Bedrock supports long-lived API keys passed as an HTTP Bearer token (`Authorization: Bearer <key>`) in addition to AWS SigV4. The base spec modelled auth as a raw `apiKey` header named `Authorization`, forcing callers to type the `Bearer ` prefix into the credential value. This overlay rewrites the component security schemes to a single HTTP bearer scheme (`bearerAuth`) and points the root `security` requirement at it. Removes target the always-present `securitySchemes` map and root `security` array before re-adding them, so the overlay is idempotent and re-applies with no warnings.

bearerAuth.description: Amazon Bedrock API key, sent as an HTTP Bearer token (`Authorization: Bearer <key>`). Bedrock also accepts AWS Signature Version 4; use a SigV4-capable credential for that path.
